description:
As an Associate AI Applications Engineer II, you will design, build, and deploy interactive user interfaces and web applications that enable users to explore, evaluate, and work with machine learning and AI models. You will translate models and data science outputs into intuitive, reliable, and scalable applications, and support the review and validation of ML/AI-enabled apps, under the direction of a more senior leader. You will demonstrate strong front-end and full-stack engineering skills and a working understanding of ML/AI model lifecycles, APIs, and data integration. 
 Responsibilities:  
 Design and develop dynamic, interactive user interfaces and applications (e.g., Streamlit, Gradio, Dash, React) that expose ML and AI models, including generative AI and agent-based solutions, to business and scientific users. 
 Integrate applications with model endpoints, APIs, and data sources, enabling real-time inference, parameter controls, visualization of results, and user feedback capture. 
 Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to turn prototypes and models into production-ready, maintainable applications. 
 Review ML/AI-enabled applications for functionality, usability, performance, security, and responsible AI considerations, and provide clear, actionable feedback. 
 Write, test, and maintain high-quality code using version control, code review, and CI/CD practices; troubleshoot and resolve application defects. 
 Gather user requirements and iterate on designs through demos, user testing, and feedback to improve usability and adoption. 
 Deploy and monitor applications on cloud and container platforms, ensuring reliability, scalability, and appropriate logging and observability. 
 Document application architecture, APIs, and user guides, and contribute to reusable components and standards for AI application development. 
 Learn and evaluate new frameworks, AI tools, and technologies, and recommend improvements to our application development approach. 
 Understand and adhere to corporate standards regarding applicable Corporate and Divisional Policies, including code of conduct, safety, GxP compliance, and data security. 
 
 Required: 
 Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field with 2 years of experience; or Master’s Degree with no additional experience.
 Respective years of relevant experience developing software or web applications. 
 Proficiency in Python and backends like FastAPI.
 Proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript; experience with React, or similar. 
 Experience building applications that consume ML/AI models via REST APIs or SDKs 
 Familiarity with ML concepts and tools (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch, MLflow) and generative AI/LLM application patterns. 
 Working knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure), containers, Git, and CI/CD 
 Strong data visualization and UX design sensibility. 
 Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical partners 
 Preferred: 
 Experience in life sciences or regulated (GxP) environments. 
 2 or more years of experience developing software or web applications preferred.
 
 Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law: ​

This range may be  modified in the future. ​

 We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.​
